title: Dashboard Staging Runway and Metrics Decision Log
content:
PURPOSE:
This doc is a lightweight, operational decision log for how we stage dashboards and metric sets from prototype -> canary -> general availability. Aim: reduce query cost surprises, keep operator workflows compact, and ensure trace anchors exist for any new SLI.

SCOPE:
- All inference-facing dashboards (hosted API + dedicated) for the next two quarters.
- Metric families introduced by feature rollouts (routing, kv-cache, prefix-cache, model-variant-fallbacks).
- Tracing sampling and span anchors tied to new panels.

KEY PRINCIPLES (quick):
- Start with a minimal microdash: 3 panels that answer a single hypothesis (health, latency tail, error rate).
- Each new panel must map to 1 investigation play (what to click next).
- Metric cost budget per dashboard: 1500 query units / day (soft); if exceeded, require a tranche pruning plan.
- Traces must have an implicit anchor: either session_id or request_path tokenized id. If sensitive, use hashed-id.

DECISION LOG (chronological):
1) 2025-11-03 - initial staging runway concept approved (owner: Asha): small-microdash -> canary (10% tenants) -> smoke (region-limited) -> GA. Rationale: catch tenant-specific cold-cache patterns early.
2) 2025-11-15 - sampling for model-fanout traces: adopt severity-weighted sampling where 100% of error responses are captured, and 1% of successful long-tail (>95th latency) are captured (owner: Ravi). Action: implement sampling hook in telemetry-proxy.
3) 2025-12-02 - metric tranche decision: any derived metric (ratio or moving-window derivative) is tagged as ephemeral and must include provenance tag (raw_metric: token.latency_ms) (owner: Tommaso).
4) 2026-01-12 - dashboard query cost enforcement: introduce a daily alert to dashboard-owner on >1200 query units/day. If repeated 3 days in 7, suspend scheduled refreshes and require optimization plan. (owner: Katherine).

METRIC DEFINITIONS (sketches - keep terse):
- inference_request.count: count of received inference calls (label: model, route, tenant_id). Purpose: baseline traffic.
- token_emit.latency_ms: per-token emission latency percentiles (p50,p90,p95,p99) (label: model, backend_pool). Use histogram buckets aligned with 1ms,5ms,10ms,25ms,50ms,100ms.
- kv_cache.hit_rate: numerator = kv_cache.hits / kv_cache.lookups. Definition note: only include in dedicated/private where KV cache enabled.
- fallback.rate: count of requests that used fallback model or region (label: fallback_type). Important SLO: <0.5% per route.
- output_quality.regressions: aggregated eval-triggered failure rate for golden prompt set (label: eval_suite). This is sampled from offline eval pipeline; live proxy will emit a flag when mismatch > threshold.

TRACE ANCHORING & SAMPLING (practical notes):
- Anchor guidance: every dashboard panel that drills into sessions must include a span.link to one of: session_id (hashed), trace_id, or tenant_request_id. Prefer tenant_request_id for multi-model fanout.
- Synthetic probe traces: create a stable probe that attaches a probe_tag=dashboard_staging for 24h windows to help compare canary vs baseline.
- Sampling knobs: severity-weighted + reservoir for tail traces per tenant (cap 50 traces/tenant/day).
- Privacy: redact prompt bodies; only keep prompt hashes and length buckets. For PHI customers, sampling must be disabled unless explicit opt-in and KMS enabled.

DASHBOARD STAGING RUNWAY (step-by-step):
- Prototype (author builds microdash locally): include 3 canonical panels, a short hypothesis, and a JIRA ticket with acceptance criteria. No query budgets enforced.
- Canary (10% tenants or single low-impact route): deploy dashboard in read-only mode to 10% of tenants; run synthetic probes; collect operator feedback. Duration: min 72h.
- Smoke (region-limited GA): turn on for a whole region; enable cost alerts; ensure trace anchors are present for 95% of queries. Duration: min 7 days.
- GA: enable global, add to folder, assign owner, and set 30-day review.

EXAMPLE ACCEPTANCE CHECKLIST (canary -> smoke):
- [ ] Hypothesis documented in JIRA (link).
- [ ] 3 microdash panels implemented and mapped to playbook actions.
- [ ] Trace anchors present and validated for sample traces.
- [ ] Query cost measured and within 1500 units/day. If not, optimization plan logged.
- [ ] No PII leakage in traces/panels (run redaction check script).
- [ ] Operator walk-through recorded (5–10min).

UNKNOWNs / QUESTIONS (open):
- How to handle dashboards that require heavy JOINs across metric streams (e.g., per-tenant cold-cache + billing tags)? Proposal: create pre-aggregated rollups with TTL 6h. Need SRE+Billing alignment. (owner: Maya)
- Should we formalize a retention policy for synthetic probe traces vs production traces? Short-term: 14 days for synthetic, 30 days for high-severity traces. Confirm with legal/security.

IMPLEMENTATION NOTES (ops nuggets):
- Use lightweight alerting: owner@ + slack channel notify, not oncall paging for first iteration. Escalate to oncall after third repeated alert in 24h.
- Provide a 'trim' script for dashboard owners: finds panels with >1M rows scanned/month and suggests rollup or downsampled series.
- For dashboards that surface model-output quality regressions, prefer offline eval hooks + a binary flag in telemetry rather than storing raw outputs.

NEXT ACTIONS (short list):
- Ravi: prototype sampling hook in telemetry-proxy (JIRA-OBS-4180) — due 2026-03-10.
- Tommaso: run query-cost audit on current inference dashboards and list top-10 panels by cost — due 2026-03-05.
- Katherine: add daily query-cost alert and template message for owners — due 2026-03-08.
- Asha: coordinate quick operator walkthrough recordings for any dashboards entering canary.

NOTES TO SELF (informal):
- Keep dashboard names short; use suffixes: -micro, -canary, -smoke. Avoid duplicating panel queries across dashboards (centralize common subqueries).
- Expect follow-up: data team will want a schema for pre-aggregations. Plan a sync.

REFERENCES and LINKS:
- Confluence: Dashboard Runway Index (linked above).
- Example PR: github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/678 (trace sampling PoC).
- JIRA: OBS-4123 (runway concept), OBS-4180 (sampling hook).

END.
